values.description: P3: USB-C relocated to bottom -Y at X=-27 beside TWO-finger camera mount. ESP32 cradle rotated and resized to clear enclosure walls. Widened 2.1 x 1.15 mm joint seal glands and uncompressed gasket masters included. 49 mm case depth excluding mount. Fit prototype only; actual active display/insert/USB interfaces remain unverified.

org.codex.p2.esp32_outline_source: User-supplied dimensioned image: 18 x 23.5 mm, R1 corners
org.codex.p2.usb_strategy: Bottom -Y X=-27 direct ESP32 USB-C; 18 x 30 x 12 mm cable envelope has 3 mm lateral clearance from mount root. Actual plug and Z stack unverified
org.codex.p2.mount_interface: TWO 3 mm fingers, one 3.3 mm gap; 5.3 mm M5 bore. No outer nut collar; use mating accessory nut receiver. M5 knob on +X side, opposite USB. Hidden nominal mating gauges and 24 mm knob allowance UNVERIFIED
org.codex.p2.joint_seal: 1.5 mm uncompressed flat silicone ring, 1.3 mm wide, in 2.1 x 1.15 mm gland; nominal cross-section fill 80.75 percent; not IP rated
org.codex.p2.pcb_support: Rear edge ledges and replaceable retaining tabs; actual display component/edge keepout unverified
org.codex.p2.remaining: Protective USB cap, plug strain relief, insert selection, display drawing, screw length/head selection, component clearance, RF, touch, heat, rain and vibration tests
org.codex.p2.native_param_note: Sketch widths/heights and extrusion depths use parameters; layout offsets and some clearances are source-configurable fixed sketch placements. Rebuild from source for wholesale layout changes.
